nodes.name: field_comparison

nodes.name: status_of
nodes.summary: Derives Completed, Partial or Unavailable from which provider results exist.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Fetches an execution and checks that it exists, belongs to the ticket and provider, and has finished running.

nodes.name: ComparisonError
nodes.summary: ValueError carrying the HTTP status code the API should return for a failed comparison.

nodes.name: csv_export.py
nodes.summary: Builds CSV exports of tickets, AI executions and comparisons from declarative column maps, omitting payloads and neutralizing spreadsheet formula injection.

nodes.name: value_at
nodes.summary: Reads a dotted path from a nested document, returning None when any step is missing.

nodes.name: cell
nodes.summary: Formats a value for CSV and prefixes a quote on cells a spreadsheet could run as formulas.

nodes.name: to_csv
nodes.summary: Writes documents to CSV text using the given header-to-path column map.

nodes.name: export
nodes.summary: Loads the named collection in sorted order and serializes it with its column map.

nodes.summary: Collapses whitespace and maps enum-like values and booleans to canonical form while keeping descriptions exact.

nodes.summary: Validates a row's ticket and optional all-or-nothing expected labels, returning ticket, label and errors.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Creates the ticket with its import source and stores any evaluation label separately.

nodes.name: import_csv
nodes.summary: Runs the import loop, keeping valid rows when others fail, skipping duplicates within the file, in the database or from a concurrent import, and writing nothing in a dry run.

nodes.name: CsvFileError
nodes.summary: Raised when the file as a whole cannot be read, so nothing is imported.

nodes.summary: Joins comparison records with their two runs and ticket in the given order, labelling deleted tickets.

nodes.name: model_of

nodes.name: detail
nodes.summary: Returns one comparison joined with its ticket and runs, or None.

nodes.name: run_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Computes pure metrics for a set of Jev-vs-LLM comparisons: per-field agreement and Cohen's kappa, latency, tokens, outcomes, cost, Jev confidence, distributions and disagreements.

nodes.name: percentile
nodes.summary: Computes a nearest-rank percentile, returning None for an empty list.

nodes.name: kappa
nodes.summary: Computes Cohen's kappa for label pairs, returning None when there are no pairs or no variety.

nodes.name: latency
nodes.summary: Summarizes run durations as count, mean, median, 90th percentile, minimum and maximum.

nodes.summary: Totals and averages provider-reported tokens and output tokens per second, never estimating unreported usage.

nodes.name: outcomes
nodes.summary: Counts runs by status and computes the success rate.

nodes.name: cost
nodes.summary: Totals the estimated cost of priced runs, returning None when no run has a price.

nodes.name: jev_confidence
nodes.summary: Averages Jev's confidence per field, overall and split by whether the LLM agreed.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Produces the full run metrics, using completed comparisons for agreement and every recorded run for latency, tokens, outcomes and cost.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formats a number with digits and a suffix, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: pct
nodes.summary: Formats a ratio as a whole percentage, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: secs
nodes.summary: Formats milliseconds as seconds, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: table
nodes.summary: Renders headers and rows as a horizontally scrollable HTML table with right-aligned numeric columns.

nodes.name: agreement_chart
nodes.summary: Draws an inline SVG of horizontal agreement bars, one per field, on a single 0-100% scale.

nodes.name: speed_chart
nodes.summary: Draws an inline SVG dumbbell chart of Jev and LLM seconds per ticket on one shared scale.

nodes.name: word
nodes.summary: Returns escaped display text for a field value, showing escalation booleans as words.

nodes.name: mark
nodes.summary: Returns the HTML marker for agree, differ or not compared.

nodes.name: ticket_rows

nodes.name: side
nodes.summary: Returns the opening HTML of a legend key with the Jev or LLM color swatch.
